educational_documentary.label: Simple educational documentary
educational_documentary.prompt: A premium editorial documentary photograph communicating one idea at a glance. One obvious subject or action, very few objects, plain uncluttered surroundings, restrained natural color, deliberate soft lighting, accurate anatomy and materials, crisp focal detail, subtle depth, generous negative space, and an immediately understandable composition. Photorealistic, polished, and calm.

clean_diagrammatic.label: Simple object visualization
clean_diagrammatic.prompt: A single clean three-dimensional object or mechanism on a plain neutral background. Show only the essential parts, with an obvious shape and relationship, restrained colors, soft studio lighting, generous empty space, and no decorative elements.

cinematic_scale.label: Simple real-world scale
cinematic_scale.prompt: A calm real-world documentary image with one main subject that makes scale or function immediately understandable. Natural perspective, grounded color, soft lighting, minimal background activity, and generous empty space.
